answers.basis: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required. The abstract must not include references.
A list of up to five keywords should be provided below the abstract.
a Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required, but it is not necessary for “Editorial” or “Commentary and Perspective”. At the header on each odd page from page 3,

answers.answer: [番号]の形式で、句点やカンマの前につける。
answers.basis: When cited in the text, reference numbers must be put in brackets in the form [1,3,5-8] before a ‘period’ or a ‘comma’.

answers.answer: 最初の6名を記載し、以降は「et al.」
answers.basis: For more than six authors, list the first six authors followed by “et al.”

answers.answer: 図: TIFF, PNG, JPEG, PDF形式、解像度300dpi。グラフィカルアブストラクト: PNG, JPEG, GIF形式、解像度300dpi
answers.basis: Figures must be at a resolution high enough for printing. ... We accept figure files in TIFF, PNG, JPEG or PDF formats. ... The format of the graphical abstract should be PNG, JPEG or GIF, and the resolution should be 300 dpi.

answers.answer: 1. 表はすべて本文中で引用されること。2. 表の番号はアラビア数字。3. 縦線を使用しない。
answers.basis: All tables must be cited in the text. Number the tables consecutively with Arabic numerals ... . Do not use vertical lines.

answers.answer: 20MB。超える場合はJ-STAGE Dataにアップロードし、編集事務局に連絡。
answers.basis: The size of each file that is uploaded ... should be no more than 20 MB. ... please upload them to another relating BPPB data repository, J-STAGE Data ... . In this case, please contact the Editorial office.
Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented”, or other similar descriptive words,
Authors who have been requested to revise their manuscript should send the revised version to the handling editor within 90 days of receiving the editorial decision.
